children.name: Platanus dissecta Lesquereux, 1878
children.description: Platanus dissecta is an extinct species of plane tree in the family Platanaceae.

children.name: Platanus gentryi Nixon & J.M.Poole
children.description: Platanus gentryi, commonly known as Gentry's plane tree, Gentry's sycamore, Sicómoro de la Sierra, or the mountain sycamore, is a species of Platanus in the family Platanaceae.

children.name: Platanus kerrii Gagnep.
children.description: Platanus kerrii (Kerr's plane) is a rare and distinctive species of plane tree (sycamore) native to the subtropical and tropical forests of Vietnam and Laos in Southeast Asia.

children.name: Platanus rzedowskii Nixon & J.M.Poole
children.description: Platanus rzedowskii, commonly known as Rzedowski's plane tree, Rzedowski's sycamore, Sicómoro de la Sierra Madre Occidental, or the Sierra Madre Occidental sycamore, is a species of Platanus in the family Platanaceae.

children.name: Platanus wrightii S.Watson
children.description: Platanus wrightii, the Arizona sycamore, is a sycamore tree native to Arizona and New Mexico with its range extending south into the Mexican states of Sonora, Chihuahua, and Sinaloa.

children.name: Platanus mexicana
children.description: Platanus mexicana is a species of plane tree that is native to Northeast and Central Mexico and Guatemala.

children.name: Platanus orientalis
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Medit. to Iran. It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Macginitiea gracilis Wolfe & Wehr, 1987
children.description: Macginitiea is an extinct genus in the family Platanaceae ranging from the Late Paleocene to Late Eocene of North America, known from the Clarno Formation of central Oregon and other areas ranging from California to Texas and North to Alberta. The genus is strictly used to describe leaves, but has been found in close association with other fossil platanoid organs, which collectively have been used for whole plant reconstructions.
